verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo centred on the main axis as in the original, but the logo is shrunk to a tiny mark, there is a dead gap between the can and the CTA, and the sticker has become a small box beside the legal line. B pushes the logo off-axis to the upper right so it aligns with nothing, and jams the CTA, legal line and sticker into the bottom edge, which crowds the bottom while the middle stays loose.

A keeps the original order (can, then headline, then CTA), but the logo is stranded off-centre at the upper right, the headline sits tight on the CTA, and the bottom cluster of CTA, legal line and sticker is cramped against the edge. B has a clean centred stack and even spacing, but the logo is shrunk to an undersized mark, the order is changed to headline above the can, and the sticker is reduced to a tiny box beside small, low-contrast legal text.
